description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git pack-object functionalities, including packing, unpacking, verification, and handling various edge cases and errors. It contains a series of test cases leveraging the Git test framework to verify the behavior of Git's packing and indexing commands.

methods.name: check_deltas
methods.description: Parses the stderr output from pack-objects to count the total number of deltas and compares it with an expected value.

methods.name: check_use_objects
methods.description: Verifies that the objects in a given pack file can be correctly accessed and match the expected data.

methods.name: test_with_bad_commit
methods.description: Tests index-pack behavior with a deliberately malformed commit object to ensure proper error detection.
